MobEffect::add.source: Muse targeted Ghidra decompile 2026-11-21 (existing project, no full analysis): the function resolves the MobEffectsComponent (hash 0xE6A1B550), grows its slot vector with the default-instance fill at MobEffect::instanceTemplate, merges the caller instance into the slot, applies attribute modifiers and fires the effect-added event. ABI: void __fastcall(void* actor, const MobEffectInstance* instance) with the instance id at +0x00, duration ticks at +0x04, amplifier at +0x20.

MobEffect::instanceTemplate.source: Muse targeted Ghidra decompile 2026-11-21: the game's default MobEffectInstance (0xA8 bytes, runtime-initialized in .data BSS; its id and duration fields are zero, which is what the entry guard records), passed as the fill value when MobEffect::add grows the slot vector and copied over slots by MobEffect::remove. Read at runtime and patched with id/duration/amplifier/showParticles to build the instance handed to MobEffect::add. Data symbol: resolved by RVA from the module base, never through the entry-guard resolver.

MobEffect::remove.source: Muse targeted Ghidra decompile 2026-11-21: removes one effect from the actor's MobEffectsComponent - calls the effect definition's modifier-removal with the actor's attribute component, then resets the slot from the default instance at MobEffect::instanceTemplate. Early-outs when the slot is already inactive. ABI: void __fastcall(void* actor, int effectId).
